body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Pure presented 'Sensia', its internet-connected digital audio system with Flow technology and a large color touchscreen on Jan. 5, 2010, at CES Unveiled at CES 2010 in Las Vegas.
It features playing internet radio content and podcasts, DAB and FM radio stations, user's music collection via Wi-Fi, online apps and unique broadcast material.
Using the touchscreen users can view scrolling and spinning lists, tapping to select, sliding controls and swiping to change views.

Sensia also features PURE Clearsound technology for impressive stereo sound, an RF remote control and an input for iPod/MP3 players. There's also an alarm, countdown and sleep timers, and a headphone socket.

Add an optional rechargeable PURE ChargePAK for hours of portable listening per charge and listen to internet or streamed content anywhere within range of your Wi-Fi network, or to FM when users are further afield.
There are also optional made-to-measure clear or mirrored screen protectors to help protect the Sensia's touchscreen.
